evidence.detail: The abstract class owns exactly a source URL and destination File plus download byte-count/start-time/content-length state; its public download method streams URL bytes into that File and returns the destination.
The downloader uses a 16 KiB BufferedInputStream buffer, obtains content length through HttpURLConnection, tracks bytes written and invokes one abstract progress callback after every chunk.
All live exact-v308 consumers are updater/download classes for main game assets, client, configs and sprites; the base itself remains generic to URL-to-file transfer.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the abstract URL-to-file streaming downloader used by the cache/client updater family.

evidence.detail: The class extends UrlFileDownloader and adds only a Client reference, caller-supplied progress label and progress-rate timestamp.

Its progress callback computes integer percent from downloaded/content-length bytes, formats transfer speed as kb/s or mb/s after one second, and publishes the progress through Client.b(percent,label,status).

Exact-v308 updater classes construct this same implementation for 'Downloading main game assets..', 'Downloading client..', 'Downloading game configs..' and 'Downloading sprites..', proving it is a shared client-progress downloader rather than one asset-specific updater.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the concrete URL file downloader that reports percentage/rate to the live Client UI.
